verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own docs describe drafting feature revisions, requesting review, and requiring approval before publishing. The API also offers a 'require confirmation' hold for risky changes, and pricing lists approval workflows as a higher-tier feature. However, the evidence does not show that approval can be scoped to the production environment specifically, so coverage of the story is partial. Missing for 10: documented per-environment (production-only) approval policies, detail on approver roles and rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration; the plan gating also limits availability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: Draft feature revisions, request review, resolve merge conflicts, and require approval before publishing.
Require confirmation holds risky changes until a person confirms them in GrowthBook.
